scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api npm run migrate
scripts.backup: docker compose exec api npm run backup
scripts.typecheck: docker compose --profile outils run --rm outils sh -c "npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run typecheck --workspaces"
scripts.icons: docker compose --profile outils run --rm outils sh -c "npm i --prefix /tmp/sharp --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent sharp && node apps/web/scripts/generate-icons.mjs"
